description.zh: 地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 诊断报告ID列表。最多支持100个ID。
description.en: The IDs of the diagnostic reports. You can specify up to 100 resource IDs.

descriptions.zh: 不支持删除诊断中的报告。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation to delete the diagnostic reports that are no longer needed.
